newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan state airliner traffic up 9.6 pct Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: Jordan state airliner traffic up 9.6 pct Jan-May.

text.p: Jordan's state carrier Royal Jordanian saw a 9.6 percent rise in passenger traffic in the first five months of 1997 compared to the same period last year, its planning department said on Wednesday.
Royal Jordanian carried 555,764 passengers from January to end of May 1997 and passenger seat factor stood at 66.2 percent against 63.9 percent in the same period last year.
Total cargo during the same five month period rose 15.7 percent to 32,008 tonnes compared to the same period last year.
Traffic was markedly higher on the Indian, North African, Gulf, Middle and Far Eastern routes the airline said.
